resolution.title: [submodule] Update swss submodule
resolution.description:
Signed-off-by: Danny Allen <<EMAIL>>

* Add DPB-ACL scale tests (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/commit/e1a5e9a239d7e7664dc1d992d41e12dc36e9ad59)
* [dvs] Update drop counter tests for SAI 1.6 (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/commit/1be35aceab100721f62cdcb81b91cb93545ce1fb)
* Bulk routes and next hop group members (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/commit/bfaadcd6957e347dc2b0980b38ef70cec55751e0)
* [vnet] Fix IP2ME route creation logic for BITMAP VNET interface (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/commit/cdffff315f10f79d4f68668540cb80c32d84c9ea)
* [MultiDB] fix wrong MultiDB APIs usage in mclags (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/commit/0e0f039b2eaa951f42361dfe1dc1f59780768f44)
* [portsyncd] fix default select timeout (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/commit/727a518159a08e245f6f37d58f796f2b9097774a)
* [proxy_arp] Implement proxy ARP feature (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/commit/47985848acc0048c4d931648ccde340df2e4ada0)
* Fixing compilation issue in 32-bit arch (marvell-armhf) (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/commit/69a980e1c7ebbe9b045927827f5e7324491094a4)
* [aclorch] Add support for creating ingress and egress MIRROR tables concurrently (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/commit/a9dbc8386794a7aea94fc71485129ebaf9fd0b62)
* [orchagent] Set default MTU for the underlay loopback interface (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/commit/e09dbc2fe0f29b775745ae8cfb86c5674afe594b)
* [vstest]: unmark fixture for create/remove_dpb_config_file (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/commit/ea002e5d942511fca5db4ac711f8ed4fb6881050)
* Corrected the copp rule as per NAT HLD (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/commit/4cc1d1f02788c9f9d2ece3c0dee61a1a6d57dacf)
* [MultiDB] Use database name instead of database ID (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/commit/2deb6e09ebca497b94a230d8ea81ed7e5d870bdf)
* Revert "[portsorch] Enable port-level buffer drop counters (#1237)" (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-swss/commit/a3a010af728345b085d8a6e344b60b16c32815fd)

**- Why I did it**
To update the submodule in master. Also fixes #4586.
